title: I’m Still Using the iPhone Air!!
description:
This is a short of the iphone air.  I've been using the iphone air for around 5 months now, and I'm surprised that I'm still using the iphone air.  This is because I thought that the iPHone air was going to be a phone that was too limited for muse case, but it's been surprisingly great.
